title: Require positive child execution evidence in federation unwind regressions
outcome: Federation unwind parents reject a child that exits successfully without executing the selected teardown case.
acceptance: The parent requires a per-mode completion marker after the child's final assertions, or equivalent positive evidence; a zero-test child invocation cannot pass solely by exit status.
A discriminating control with a nonmatching exact filter or absent marker fails while every real unwind mode still passes; timeouts and existing teardown assertions are preserved.
